02 — About

A structured thinker with a bias for evidence

I'm an MSc Business Analysis & Consulting student at Strathclyde Business School, holding the SBS Dean's Excellence Scholarship on the strength of my undergraduate record. My BBA from Maharaja Surajmal Institute (GGSIPU) — CGPA 8.29/10, Institute Rank 77 — gave me the grounding in strategy, operations and quantitative methods I now apply at postgraduate level.

My strongest work sits at the intersection of data and decision-making: a Monte Carlo–validated digital inclusion framework built for Hippo Digital ahead of the UK's 2031 Census as academic project, a self-directed Power BI diagnostic uncovering the root causes behind £154M in Barclays' regulatory fines, and strategic scenario planning for Rolls-Royce using VRIN/RBV and Cairns & Wright's intuitive logics. I work comfortably in Excel, Power BI, DAX and SQL, and I'm equally at home structuring a messy problem as I am modelling one.

Originally from New Delhi, now based in Glasgow, I'm looking for graduate opportunities in business analysis and consulting where careful reasoning and clear communication are valued as much as the answer itself.

Mission

To turn complex, ambiguous problems into clear, evidence-based recommendations that hold up under scrutiny.

Vision

To build a career in consulting where rigorous analysis and genuine client impact go hand in hand.

05 — Projects

Relevant Projects

Each project follows the same structure: understand the problem, apply the right framework, and land on a recommendation that holds up under scrutiny.

05 featured

ONS Census 2031 Digital Inclusion Prioritisation Framework

University of Strathclyde · Group Project · Client: Hippo Digital

A prioritisation framework built to help identify which of the UK's 328 Local Authorities most need digital inclusion support ahead of the 2031 Census, combining multi-criteria decision analysis with a probabilistic simulation to stress-test the results.

01 Ranked all 328 Local Authorities by digital inclusion need, giving ONS a ready-to-use rollout priority order
02 1,000-iteration Monte Carlo simulation confirmed rankings hold under uncertain weighting assumptions
03 Cross-validated against ONS's own Deprivation Priority Index, so findings could be trusted by the client without independent re-checking
04 Individual reflection using the Gould Pyramid framework
MCDAMonte Carlo SimulationDirichlet DistributionExcel

Barclays Regulatory Risk Diagnostic — FCA Enforcement 2015–2025

Self-Directed Project

A self-initiated diagnostic of £154M in Barclays' FCA regulatory fines, built to identify root causes and benchmark exposure against 8 UK peer banks — then translated into a phased set of recommendations, not just a dashboard.

01 Traced 98% of penalty value to governance failures rather than technical control gaps — redirecting where fixes should focus
02 Benchmarked against 8 peer banks to reveal Barclays' exposure sits at 3.9x the sector average
03 Built a 3-page interactive Power BI dashboard with DAX-driven measures, turning raw enforcement data into a decision-ready narrative
04 Delivered 3 prioritised recommendations via an Effort-Impact framework, targeting £151M of governance-driven fine value with a phased 12-month rollout
Power BIDAXData ModellingRoot-Cause AnalysisEffort-Impact Framework

Rolls-Royce Holdings — Strategic Scenario Analysis

University of Strathclyde · Individual Assignment · SMM

A two-part strategic analysis of Rolls-Royce: first assessing its aftermarket servicing model as a core capability through Sminia's VRIN/RBV lens, then building four named future scenarios using Cairns & Wright's eight-stage intuitive logics methodology.

01 Identified aftermarket servicing as the capability worth defending — and where to invest — via VRIN/RBV
02 Tested SMR diversification as a growth bet before committing resource to it
03 Flagged the environmental drivers most likely to force a strategy change, via PESTEL-driven mapping
04 Delivered a client-ready advisory report, scored distinction marks
VRIN/RBVScenario PlanningPESTEL
